name: Lost Reverie
source: You play as Jonathan — a detective burdened by a past he cannot remember and a wound that shattered his mind, awakening fragments of forgotten memories. At the center of the story lies the investigation of a brutal massacre in a residential district, one that quickly grows into something far greater than an ordinary criminal case.
